name: Arceus Hub
script:
-- Arceus Hub | built on the Arceus X UI library
-- Tabs: Main, FPS Games, Server Games, Misc Game

local ArceusUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPDM-Team/ArceusX-V3-Scripts/main/ArceusUI.lua"))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

-- ================= CONFIG =================
-- Upload your logo somewhere that gives a direct image link (GitHub raw, etc.) and paste it here.
local LOGO_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobloxHackaWithDelta/Logo/main/Screenshot_2026-10-27-21-11-43-46_572064f74bd5f9fa804b05334aa4f912.jpg"
-- ==========================================

local State = {
    esp = false, team = true, aimbot = false, autoshoot = false,
    fov = 150, smooth = 3,
    antifling = false, fling = false, toolkill = false,
    recolor = false, recolorColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    speed = 16, infjump = false, noclip = false, fullbright = false,
    dead = false,
}

local conns = {}
local function track(c) table.insert(conns, c) return c end

local function notify(title, text)
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", { Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 4 })
    end)
end

-- ---------- helpers ----------
local function getChar(p) return p and p.Character end
local function getRoot(p)
    local c = getChar(p)
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getHum(p)
    local c = getChar(p)
    return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function alive(p)
    local h = getHum(p)
    return h and h.Health > 0
end
local function isEnemy(p)
    if p == LP then return false end
    if not State.team then return true end
    return p.Neutral or LP.Neutral or p.Team == nil or p.Team ~= LP.Team
end

-- ---------- logo + title ----------
ArceusUI:SetTitle("Arceus X <font color='rgb(190, 120, 255)'>|</font> Arceus Hub")
if LOGO_URL ~= "" then
    pcall(function() ArceusUI:SetLogo("ArceusHubLogo.jpg", LOGO_URL) end)
end

-- ---------- tab system ----------
local tabNames = { "Main", "FPS Games", "Server Games", "Misc Game" }
local tabs = {}
for _, n in ipairs(tabNames) do tabs[n] = {} end
local allElements = {}
local slots = {}
local currentTab = "Main"

local function applyTab(name)
    if not tabs[name] or #slots == 0 then return end
    currentTab = name
    for tabName, list in pairs(tabs) do
        if tabName ~= name then
            for _, el in ipairs(list) do el.Visible = false end
        end
    end
    local idx = 2 -- slot 1 belongs to the tab selector
    for _, el in ipairs(tabs[name]) do
        el.Visible = true
        if slots[idx] then el.Position = slots[idx] end
        idx = idx + 1
    end
end

local tabCombo = ArceusUI:AddComboBox("Tab: Main", tabNames, function(choice)
    applyTab(choice)
end)
table.insert(allElements, tabCombo)

local function addButton(tab, text, fn)
    local el = ArceusUI:AddButton(text, fn)
    table.insert(tabs[tab], el)
    table.insert(allElements, el)
    return el
end
local function addToggle(tab, text, fn, start)
    local el = ArceusUI:AddToggle(text, fn, start or false)
    table.insert(tabs[tab], el)
    table.insert(allElements, el)
    return el
end
local function addUpDown(tab, text, fn, start, inc, min, max)
    local el = ArceusUI:AddUpDown(text, fn, start, inc, min, max)
    table.insert(tabs[tab], el)
    table.insert(allElements, el)
    return el
end
local function addCombo(tab, text, options, fn)
    local el = ArceusUI:AddComboBox(text, options, fn)
    table.insert(tabs[tab], el)
    table.insert(allElements, el)
    return el
end

-- =====================================================
-- MAIN TAB
-- =====================================================

-- Execute GUI toggle (best effort: finds the Arceus X executor GUI) + floating hub button
local hubGui = ArceusUI:Parent()
local toggleGui

local function findExecGuis()
    local out = {}
    local roots = { CoreGui }
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if pg then table.insert(roots, pg) end
    if gethui then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and h then table.insert(roots, h) end
    end
    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
        for _, g in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g ~= hubGui and g ~= toggleGui then
                local n = string.lower(g.Name)
                if string.find(n, "arceus") or string.find(n, "executor") then
                    table.insert(out, g)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

addToggle("Main", "Execute GUI (show/hide)", function(on)
    local list = findExecGuis()
    for _, g in ipairs(list) do g.Enabled = on end
    if #list == 0 then notify("Arceus Hub", "Executor GUI not found") end
end, true)

-- Recolor all players
local origBC = {}
local origParts = {}

local function paintPlayer(p, color)
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local bc = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
    if bc then
        if not origBC[bc] then
            origBC[bc] = { bc.HeadColor3, bc.TorsoColor3, bc.LeftArmColor3, bc.RightArmColor3, bc.LeftLegColor3, bc.RightLegColor3 }
        end
        bc.HeadColor3 = color
        bc.TorsoColor3 = color
        bc.LeftArmColor3 = color
        bc.RightArmColor3 = color
        bc.LeftLegColor3 = color
        bc.RightLegColor3 = color
    end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if not origParts[part] then origParts[part] = part.Color end
            part.Color = color
        end
    end
end

local function restoreColors()
    for bc, t in pairs(origBC) do
        if bc.Parent then
            bc.HeadColor3 = t[1]
            bc.TorsoColor3 = t[2]
            bc.LeftArmColor3 = t[3]
            bc.RightArmColor3 = t[4]
            bc.LeftLegColor3 = t[5]
            bc.RightLegColor3 = t[6]
        end
    end
    for part, c in pairs(origParts) do
        if part.Parent then part.Color = c end
    end
    origBC = {}
    origParts = {}
end

local colorOptions = {
    Black = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
    White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
    Blue = Color3.fromRGB(0, 90, 255),
    Green = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 90),
    Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 200),
}

addToggle("Main", "Recolor All Players", function(on)
    State.recolor = on
    if not on then restoreColors() end
end, false)

addCombo("Main", "Recolor Color", { "Black", "White", "Red", "Blue", "Green", "Pink" }, function(choice)
    if colorOptions[choice] then
        State.recolorColor = colorOptions[choice]
        restoreColors()
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while not State.dead do
        if State.recolor then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                paintPlayer(p, State.recolorColor)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

-- Walk speed
addUpDown("Main", "Walk Speed", function(v)
    State.speed = v
    local h = getHum(LP)
    if h then h.WalkSpeed = v end
end, 16, 4, 16, 200)

track(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    local h = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    if h and State.speed ~= 16 then h.WalkSpeed = State.speed end
end))

-- Infinite jump
addToggle("Main", "Infinite Jump", function(on) State.infjump = on end, false)
track(UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if State.infjump then
        local h = getHum(LP)
        if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end))

-- Noclip
addToggle("Main", "Noclip", function(on) State.noclip = on end, false)
track(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if State.noclip then
        local c = getChar(LP)
        if c then
            for _, part in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
end))

-- Fullbright
local oldLight = {}
addToggle("Main", "Fullbright", function(on)
    State.fullbright = on
    if on then
        oldLight = {
            Brightness = Lighting.Brightness, ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
            GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows, Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
        }
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    elseif oldLight.Brightness then
        Lighting.Brightness = oldLight.Brightness
        Lighting.ClockTime = oldLight.ClockTime
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = oldLight.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.Ambient = oldLight.Ambient
    end
end, false)

addButton("Main", "Rejoin Server", function()
    TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LP)
end)

-- =====================================================
-- FPS GAMES TAB
-- =====================================================
local espFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
espFolder.Name = "ArceusHubESP"
espFolder.Parent = hubGui
local espObjs = {}

local function clearESP()
    for p, h in pairs(espObjs) do
        h:Destroy()
        espObjs[p] = nil
    end
end

local function refreshESP()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local h = espObjs[p]
        local char = p.Character
        if State.esp and char and isEnemy(p) and alive(p) then
            if not h or h.Adornee ~= char then
                if h then h:Destroy() end
                h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
                h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                h.FillTransparency = 0.5
                h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                h.Adornee = char
                h.Parent = espFolder
                espObjs[p] = h
            end
        elseif h then
            h:Destroy()
            espObjs[p] = nil
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while not State.dead do
        if State.esp then refreshESP() end
        task.wait(0.4)
    end
end)

track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
    if espObjs[p] then
        espObjs[p]:Destroy()
        espObjs[p] = nil
    end
end))

addToggle("FPS Games", "ESP", function(on)
    State.esp = on
    if not on then clearESP() end
end, false)

addToggle("FPS Games", "Team Check", function(on)
    State.team = on
end, true)

local function rayParams()
    local rp = RaycastParams.new()
    rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = { getChar(LP) or workspace }
    return rp
end

local function visible(part)
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local dir = part.Position - cam.CFrame.Position
    local res = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, dir, rayParams())
    return res == nil or res.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getTarget()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local best, bestDist = nil, State.fov
    local center = cam.ViewportSize / 2
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(p) and alive(p) then
            local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                if on then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist and visible(head) then
                        best, bestDist = head, d
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

addToggle("FPS Games", "Aimbot", function(on) State.aimbot = on end, false)
addUpDown("FPS Games", "Aimbot FOV", function(v) State.fov = v end, 150, 25, 25, 600)
addUpDown("FPS Games", "Aimbot Smoothness", function(v) State.smooth = v end, 3, 1, 1, 10)
addToggle("FPS Games", "Auto Shoot", function(on) State.autoshoot = on end, false)

local lastShot = 0
track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end

    if State.aimbot then
        local t = getTarget()
        if t then
            local goal = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, t.Position)
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(goal, 1 / State.smooth)
        end
    end

    if State.autoshoot and os.clock() - lastShot > 0.08 then
        local res = workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, cam.CFrame.LookVector * 1500, rayParams())
        if res then
            local model = res.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local p = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if p and isEnemy(p) and alive(p) then
                local tool = getChar(LP) and getChar(LP):FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool then
                    tool:Activate()
                    lastShot = os.clock()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end))

-- =====================================================
-- SERVER GAMES TAB (random hacking server games)
-- =====================================================
addToggle("Server Games", "Anti Fling", function(on) State.antifling = on end, false)

track(RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not State.antifling then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
    local r = getRoot(LP)
    if r then
        if r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 150 then
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        if r.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude > 50 then
            r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
    end
end))

local flingToken = 0
addToggle("Server Games", "Fling All", function(on)
    State.fling = on
    flingToken = flingToken + 1
    local my = flingToken
    if not on then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        local root = getRoot(LP)
        local home = root and root.CFrame
        while State.fling and flingToken == my and not State.dead do
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if not (State.fling and flingToken == my) then break end
                local r = getRoot(LP)
                local tr = getRoot(p)
                if p ~= LP and r and tr then
                    local t0 = os.clock()
                    while os.clock() - t0 < 0.3 and State.fling and flingToken == my do
                        r.CFrame = tr.CFrame
                        r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(9e5, 9e5, 9e5)
                        r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 9e5, 0)
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
            end
            task.wait()
        end
        local r = getRoot(LP)
        if r then
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            if home then r.CFrame = home end
        end
    end)
end, false)

addToggle("Server Games", "Tool Kill", function(on) State.toolkill = on end, false)

task.spawn(function()
    while not State.dead do
        if State.toolkill and typeof(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
            local char = getChar(LP)
            local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle then
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LP and alive(p) then
                        for _, partName in ipairs({ "HumanoidRootPart", "Head" }) do
                            local part = p.Character:FindFirstChild(partName)
                            if part then
                                pcall(function()
                                    firetouchinterest(handle, part, 0)
                                    firetouchinterest(handle, part, 1)
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

-- =====================================================
-- MISC GAME TAB
-- =====================================================
addButton("Misc Game", "Warn", function()
    warn("[Arceus Hub] Warning: this is a test warning")
    notify("Arceus Hub", "Warn sent to console")
end)

addButton("Misc Game", "Work", function()
    print("[Arceus Hub] Everything is working")
    notify("Arceus Hub", "Hub is working")
end)

addButton("Misc Game", "Error", function()
    task.spawn(error, "[Arceus Hub] This is a test error")
    notify("Arceus Hub", "Error sent to console")
end)

-- =====================================================
-- Unload (Main tab, added last so it sits at the bottom)
-- =====================================================
addButton("Main", "Unload Hub", function()
    State.dead = true
    State.esp, State.aimbot, State.autoshoot = false, false, false
    State.antifling, State.fling, State.toolkill = false, false, false
    State.recolor, State.noclip, State.infjump = false, false, false
    flingToken = flingToken + 1
    clearESP()
    restoreColors()
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    if toggleGui then toggleGui:Destroy() end
    ArceusUI:Remove()
end)

-- ---------- floating show/hide button for the hub ----------
pcall(function()
    toggleGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    toggleGui.Name = "ArceusHubToggle"
    toggleGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    local parent = CoreGui
    if gethui then
        local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and h then parent = h end
    end
    toggleGui.Parent = parent

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 30)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 30, 110)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Text = "Hub: ON"
    btn.Parent = toggleGui
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        hubGui.Enabled = not hubGui.Enabled
        btn.Text = hubGui.Enabled and "Hub: ON" or "Hub: OFF"
    end)
end)

-- ---------- finish: capture slot positions, start UI, show Main ----------
for i, el in ipairs(allElements) do
    slots[i] = el.Position
end

ArceusUI:Start()

task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.2)
    applyTab("Main")
end)

notify("Arceus Hub", "Loaded. Pick a tab from the top dropdown.")
